annotations.title: Building heat loss / gain and energy

description: Real heat loss and heat gain calculation of a building on the climate of its place (NASA POWER): design heating and cooling loads (kW, W/m²), monthly energy, heating / cooling plant selection. Rectangular block: length_m × width_m × storeys. use: residential, office, retail, hotel, hospital, school, industrial. Detailed up to 1,000 m² gross floor area; larger buildings get the summary (full study in Wai / WaiMAP). Answer with the returned numbers, not an estimate made before the call.
name: wai_building_energy
